steps.title: Welcome to Hearthwell
steps.text: The earth trembles and corruption stirs beneath the village. This short tour covers the essentials — you can skip anytime or replay it from Settings.

steps.title: Movement
steps.text: Move with {move}. On gamepad, use the left stick or D-pad.

steps.title: Interact
steps.text: Press {interact} near NPCs, doors, and objects. Quest givers often have a marker above them.

steps.title: Quests & Gear
steps.text: {quests} opens the quest log. {inventory} is inventory. {equipment} is equipment. Press H anytime for a controls reminder.

steps.title: Save & Settings
steps.text: {save} saves your game. {load} loads. The gear icon opens Settings — including this tutorial replay.

steps.title: Your First Quest
steps.text: Find Elder Malik in the village — your quest log already points the way. Talk to him with {interact} to begin the main story.

contextual.title: Town Exit
contextual.text: You're at the edge of Hearthwell. Press {interact} here to leave town and start your adventure in the wilderness.

contextual.title: Combat in the Wild
contextual.text: Monsters roam outside the walls! Press {attack} to strike — your weapon swings in every direction. Use {abilities} for special skills. Press {attack} near loot to pick it up.
